QuestInfo.name: Purchasing a Disguise
QuestInfo.0: You wonder what kind of secret proposition #b#p2153000##k could have. Talk to him and find out.
QuestInfo.1: #p2153000#, part of the Black Wing management, says he'll sell you his #b#t1003134##k. With his hat, the gatekeepers will surely let you in. He wants #b100000 mesos#k for it.\n\n#b100000 mesos#k
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t1003134#. #p2153000#, laughing, said he'll sell you another if you ever need it. He really is an unpleasant man, but at least you can enter the Mine now.

0.0: See, I'm a member of the Black Wings. I'm allowed to enter the Mine. So, if you wear my hat, the gatekeepers won't stop you from entering.
0.1: Obviously, my hat likes mesos. You'll have to give me some. I'll give you the #b#t1003134##k in exchange for some mesos...
0.2: It's not like any of the bosses check on this kind of thing. Besides, money is the most important thing in this world. I've got to make some somehow...

yes.0: That'll cost you #b100,000 Mesos#k. It's really not that expensive... although I got it for free... Just let me know when you have enough money.

no.0: You don't have to buy it if you don't want to. There are a lot of others who want it.

1.0: Did you bring the 100,000 Mesos? Good, good. Let's make the trade.

yes.0: You'll be able pass by the gatekeepers at the Mine Entrance freely if you wear that. They are the only ones who are watching, so once you make it past them, no one will care what your wearing. Hehe...
yes.1: Come back to me if you lose the hat. I should have received a new hat by the time you come back. Hehe...

default.0: What?? You don't have the #b100,000 Mesos#k yet? Geez, I picked the wrong customer. Don't you want to enter the mine?
